title: Kiểm tra tuần 8: Viết đoạn văn mạch lạc
passage:
Over the last decade, online learning has become a significant part of higher education. Many universities now offer courses that students can access from any location, and some research suggests that this approach benefits learners who work full-time or live far from a campus.

However, the data also show a clear challenge. Completion rates for online courses are generally lower than those for traditional classes. One major factor is motivation: without regular contact with teachers and classmates, individual students may find it difficult to keep studying. This problem appears to be most serious for younger students, who often require more guidance.

To respond to this issue, several institutions have adopted a 'blended' method, which combines online lessons with occasional face-to-face meetings. Early results from these programmes are encouraging. Students report feeling more connected, and fewer of them leave their courses before the end.

Nevertheless, experts argue that technology alone cannot replace good teaching. In their view, the most effective courses are those designed around the needs of learners rather than the tools available.

questions.q: In an IELTS Writing Task 2 essay, where should you first state your main opinion clearly?
options: In the middle of the second body paragraph
questions.explain: Quan điểm chính (thesis) nên nêu rõ ngay ở mở bài, rồi nhắc lại ở kết bài.
questions.explain_en: Your main opinion (thesis) should be stated clearly in the introduction and repeated in the conclusion.

questions.q: Choose the best paraphrase of: 'Many young people cannot find jobs.'
options: Young people do not want to work.
Many jobs are given to young people.
Unemployment affects a large number of young people.
Young people find jobs very easily.
questions.explain: Đổi từ (cannot find jobs → unemployment) mà vẫn giữ nguyên nghĩa.
questions.explain_en: It changes the words (cannot find jobs → unemployment) while keeping the same meaning.

questions.q: Which sentence has the same meaning as: 'The government should spend more money on public transport.'?
options: More money should be spent on public transport by the government.
The government spends a lot of money on public transport.
Public transport should spend more money on the government.
The government should not spend money on public transport.
questions.explain: Đổi cấu trúc sang bị động mà không đổi nghĩa là một cách paraphrase.
questions.explain_en: Changing the structure to the passive without changing the meaning is one way to paraphrase.

questions.q: Many cities have introduced bike-sharing schemes. ___ schemes have helped to reduce traffic in some areas.
questions.explain: Từ thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều schemes là These.
questions.explain_en: The word that refers back to the plural noun schemes is These.

questions.q: Online courses are flexible. ___, they are often cheaper than traditional courses.
questions.explain: Câu sau bổ sung thêm một ưu điểm nên dùng In addition.
questions.explain_en: The second sentence adds another advantage, so use In addition.

questions.q: There has been ___ in the number of international students.
questions.explain: Cụm danh từ học thuật đúng: a + tính từ + danh từ (a significant increase).
questions.explain_en: The correct academic noun phrase is a + adjective + noun (a significant increase).

questions.q: ___ internet has changed the way people study and work.
questions.explain: Internet là thứ duy nhất, luôn đi với mạo từ the.
questions.explain_en: The internet is unique, so it always takes the article the.

questions.q: Find the error: 'Although she studied hard, but she failed the exam.'
questions.explain: Tiếng Anh không dùng although và but cùng lúc; cần bỏ but.
questions.explain_en: English does not use although and but together; remove but.

questions.q: Researchers need to ___ the data carefully before drawing conclusions.
questions.explain: Sau need to cần động từ nguyên mẫu: analyse.
questions.explain_en: After need to we need the base form of the verb: analyse.

questions.q: Regular exercise has a positive ___ on mental health.
questions.explain: Collocation: have a positive effect on; effect là danh từ, affect là động từ.
questions.explain_en: Collocation: have a positive effect on; effect is a noun, affect is a verb.

questions.q: This method is not ___ for very young children because it requires a lot of reading.
questions.explain: Sau be (is not) cần tính từ appropriate (phù hợp).
questions.explain_en: After be (is not) we need the adjective appropriate (suitable).

questions.q: Governments should ___ new policies to protect workers' rights.
questions.explain: Collocation học thuật: implement a policy (thực thi chính sách).

questions.q: True, False or Not Given? Online courses usually have higher completion rates than traditional classes.
questions.explain: Bài đọc nói tỷ lệ hoàn thành khóa online thường thấp hơn lớp truyền thống.
questions.explain_en: The passage says completion rates for online courses are usually lower than for traditional classes.

questions.q: True, False or Not Given? Blended programmes are cheaper for universities to run than fully online courses.
questions.explain: Bài đọc không đề cập đến chi phí của các chương trình.
questions.explain_en: The passage does not mention the cost of the programmes.

questions.q: Complete the sentence: A 'blended' method combines online lessons with ___.
questions.explain: Đoạn 3 nói phương pháp kết hợp bài học online với các buổi gặp trực tiếp thỉnh thoảng.
questions.explain_en: Paragraph 3 says the method combines online lessons with occasional face-to-face meetings.
